branch: optimization/v2 (directly from master; sibling of v1)
variants: See run_experiments.py; v1 and original archive builds; v2 working source hashes in source-provenance.json
numeric: f32/f32/f32 y+=Ax, no global fast-math; v2 TU ffp-contract=off, local ordered scalar row kernel
pilot: 180 processes, 3 per condition; predeclared conservative rules retained. Medium cache-resident calibration above serial threshold still favors forced serial: known limit, no claim of optimal threshold.
large_design: Every thread 1/12/24 x repeats 1/9/100, 10 adjacent randomized AB/BA independent process pairs. Additional R9 controls have 5 processes each.
same_binary: Separate diagnostic binary links renamed fixed v1 modules alongside original and v2. One warmup per backend; five-rank rotated order, 10 rounds, every method in each rank twice. Includes matched-FP v2 generic CSR. Within-process samples are not independent process replications.
intervals: Paired bootstrap over process pairs, fixed seed 20261026, 20000 resamples, percentile 95%; no removal of slow samples.
acceptance: At least 5% median total-time reduction on large R9 versus original best tested thread setting, interval supporting benefit; 5% is project policy, not literature theorem.
exclusions: MTX data, archives and binaries remain local ignored files. Failed SuiteSparse TLS download replaced with NIST bcsstk18/sherman5; URLs, headers and hashes retained. No STREAM or hardware DRAM bandwidth claim.
constraints: No concurrent benchmarks; OMP_DYNAMIC FALSE, PLACES cores, PROC_BIND spread, WAIT_POLICY PASSIVE; original CSR source unchanged.
diagnostic_amendment: Before first diagnostic run: add matched-FP CSR control for direct short8 attribution. Primary/core frozen; all primary samples retained. Source amendment recorded in source-provenance.json.
